title: An agent's hand-back refuses when its report names a commit that does not exist
why: Four Haiku test-author runs in lane comment-check-scans-shell made no edit and reported commit hashes that do not exist (8c1f0e2a7, 5b7d10a42, e7c35b1d0, 3d2a91f4c; git cat-file fails on each; no guard refused). The orchestrator nearly took a false 'done' (coordinator, 01:29 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: at an agent's stop, check each commit hash in its report with `git cat-file -e`; a missing hash refuses the hand-back and names it. Red case first: a report with one made-up hash; control: a report whose hashes all exist. Owner item 406 (a Sonnet test-author for the same lane) was withdrawn: the resumed Haiku test-author landed real commit cae2ccba6. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 01:31 CST Nov 8. Lane session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC started it (coordinator, 01:39 CST Nov 8). The send_message shape (coordinator, 02:12 CST Nov 8) is not covered here: this check judges only an agent's hand-back and stop, against the agent's own cwd (lane, 02:15 CST). It moved to step send-message-refs-resolve. Built as PR #1842, head 6a9543c66, with runner 8; lint PASS, review round 2 PASS. Four review notes filed in docs/debts/notes.md (report-sha-*); on merge, check each names a Fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7), as step notes-1796-fix-lines does for #1796 (lane, 02:29 CST Nov 8). Lane 13:21 CST Nov 8: #2235 (refs in messages between sessions) handed to runner 8 at 660db61b0; lane lint passes; record issuecomment-6725911362. #1864 closed as replaced. Merge after #1842.
